claimBoundary: This proves production Vercel rendering, user-facing first-screen simplification, wallet popup gating, real Chrome handoff, user-authorized browser-wallet writes, and the final canonical consequence observed through contract reads. It does not claim full transaction receipts for write hashes that were only visible as shortened UI hashes, a REMEDIATED verdict, production security, repository adoption, Portal submission, or Portal acceptance.
